## NSTelemetryTraces.startSpan() method

Start a span and return its handle.

**Signature:**

```typescript
startSpan(
    name: string,
    options?: { attributes?: Record<string, string | number | boolean>; parent?: string },
  ): string;
```

An opaque handle to pass to the other methods, or an empty string when telemetry is off.

## Example


```js
const span = ns.telemetry.traces.startSpan("prepareServer", { attributes: { target } });
// ... work ...
```
